name: Sunstone House
description: Agent guide for Sunstone House (sunstonehousepdx.com): furnished monthly rooms in a shared house in Kenton, North Portland, for working professionals. There is no remote MCP server endpoint; the site exposes its tools in-browser via WebMCP on the homepage, and publishes machine-readable room, rate, and availability data in llms.txt and index.md.

tools.name: list_open_rooms
tools.description: List the Sunstone House rooms currently open for monthly stays, with monthly rates in USD.

tools.name: get_room_details
tools.description: Get the monthly rate, bed, size, and availability for one Sunstone House room, by room name (for example Opal) or room code (for example A2).

room.description: Room name or room code, for example Opal or A2.
